title: Pure Relinquished
summary: Pure Relinquished and Eyes Restrict control build focused on absorbing opponent monsters as Equip Spells to steal their ATK and shut down their plays, supported by generic Ritual and Fusion staples. The strategy bypasses destruction immunity by vacuuming threats directly into the Spell and Trap Zone.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds both Black Illusion Ritual and Relinquished together from the Deck and GY in a single card.
Relinquished Fusion fuses materials from your hand, field, or banishment, and banishes itself from the GY to equip an effect monster your opponent controls to an Eyes Restrict Fusion Monster.
Instant Fusion pays 1000 LP to summon Thousand-Eyes Restrict or Millennium-Eyes Restrict straight from the Extra Deck without needing tribute or fusion materials.

Golden-Eyes Idol reveals itself in hand to peek at the opponent's hand and copy Thousand-Eyes Idol's name, and when banished as Fusion material, it equips an opponent's effect monster to your Eyes Restrict monster.

summary.title: Opening: Pre-Preparation of Rites + Relinquished Fusion
steps: Activate Pre-Preparation of Rites to search Relinquished and Black Illusion Ritual from your Deck.
Activate Black Illusion Ritual, tributing a Level 1 monster or extra material to Ritual Summon Relinquished.
Activate Relinquished's effect to target and absorb an opponent's monster as an Equip Spell, gaining its ATK and DEF.
Set Relinquished Fusion or keep Millennium-Eyes Illusionist in hand to absorb additional threats during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Nightmare-Eyes Restrict requires no Relinquished as material; it equips an opponent's monster on Special Summon and after each battle, and forces all opposing monsters to attack only it.
Millennium-Eyes Restrict equips an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect whenever they activate a monster effect, negating that monster and all cards with that same original name.
Thousand-Eyes Restrict absorbs an opponent's monster and prevents all other monsters on the field from attacking or changing battle positions.
Relinquished Anima uses any Level 1 monster to Link Summon a monster that immediately equips any opponent monster in the column it points to.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Relinquished Fusion is a Quick-Play Spell that performs Fusion Summons using materials from hand, field, or GY, and can banish itself from the GY as a Quick Effect to steal another monster.
Black Illusion Ritual provides the dedicated Level 1 tribute requirement for Ritual Summoning Relinquished.

Millennium-Eyes Illusionist discards itself from hand as a Quick Effect to equip an opponent's effect monster to an Eyes Restrict monster, and recurs to hand whenever an Eyes Restrict Fusion is summoned.
Illusionist Faceless Magician Special Summons itself from hand or GY when an Eyes Restrict is destroyed, and revives an Eyes Restrict monster when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion is not yet released in the TCG, Samsara D Lotus belongs strictly with Yubel, and Sacrifice Level-Up requires Xyz Monsters which this list does not run.

exclude.Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion: Not released in the TCG yet.
exclude.Samsara D Lotus: Tagged Relinquished, but every effect needs a Yubel monster; it plays on the Yubel list.
exclude.Sacrifice Level-Up: Tagged Relinquished, but it ranks up an Xyz Monster and the deck has none.
